subject: Private deployment demo — availability, tenant isolation and SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medsure.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: rajiv.menon@medsure.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment — initial interest and SOC2 request

Hi Priya,

We signed up for Redwood's self-serve trial and are interested in a short technical demo focused on Private deployment (VPC / tenant isolation). We're evaluating vendors for an on-prem / VPC setup for regulated patient data and would like to understand:

- isolation guarantees (single-tenant vs multi-tenant options)
- key management options (KMS/HSM integration)
- audit logs / retention controls
- network connectivity (IP allowlists, peering)

Can we schedule a 45-minute demo next week? Prefer PST mornings. Also: could you share your latest SOC 2 report or an SOC2 summary we can review prior to the call? Security will want to see it.

Attaching a short RFP summary for context (we'll provide more during the call).

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Director of Infrastructure
MediSure Health

Attachment: Medisecure_RFP_summary.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medsure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — initial interest and SOC2 request

Alex — great to hear from you, thanks for the context. Happy to run the demo and walk through tenant isolation, KMS options, and audit logs.

Quick notes / ask before we lock a slot:
- Can your security lead (Rajiv) attend the call? He was CC'd — perfect if he can join.
- Do you want an on-prem package deep-dive (network diagram + firewall/proxy requirements) or a VPC-focused session? We can tailor the demo to either.

Proposed slots (all PST mornings):
- Tue 2027-04-13 09:00-09:45
- Wed 2027-04-14 10:30-11:15
- Thu 2027-04-15 08:30-09:15

I've attached our redacted SOC 2 summary and a short private-deploy checklist for pre-demo review. If those look good, we'll include a short runbook and the recommended sequence (architecture -> demo -> Q&A).

Attachments: MediSure_SOC2_v3.pdf (redacted stub), Redwood_private_deploy_checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

If none of those windows work, tell me your team's availability and we'll match it.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Note: Ben (copied) will lead the technical portion; Neha is our solutions manager and will cover compliance questions.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medsure.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment — initial interest and SOC2 request

Alex / Priya — quick update: I can run the tech demo but I have an internal all-hands that conflicts with the Tue 9:00 slot. Thu 8:30 PST also conflicts for me (overnight travel).

Would you be able to do Fri 2027-04-16 09:30-10:15 PST instead? That gives us time to pre-stage a short network diagram tailored to your environment. Rajiv — if you can send any existing VPN/peering constraints or the preferred connectivity model (site-to-site VPN vs VPC peering), I'll draft the diagram.

Also, for the on-prem variant: we'll need a one-page network diagram (stubs are fine) and a list of IP ranges your security team can open for initial testing. If you prefer, we can run the first session over Teams / Zoom and then follow with a dedicated network review with your infra folks.

Attachment: network_diagram_vpc.png (stub)

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medsure.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medsure.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Private deployment demo — Fri 2027-04-16 (rescheduled) / follow-ups

Thanks everyone — confirming the slot for Fri 2027-04-16 09:30-10:15 PST. Ben will lead the demo; Neha will cover compliance items and SOC2 questions.

Next steps for MedisSure team (Alex / Rajiv):
- If you have a short network diagram, please drop it in the thread or email it to me before Thu 2027-04-15 EOD. Ben will use it to tailor the demo.
- If there are specific audit items you want covered (log retention windows, encryption-at-rest specifics), list them and we'll prepare brief slides.

I've attached the SOC2 summary again and included a calendar invite (calendar_invite.ics) — please accept so we have the right attendee list.

If anything changes, reply here and we'll reschedule. Looking forward to the conversation.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MediSure_SOC2_v3.pdf, network_diagram_vpc.png, calendar_invite.ics
